fields.description: The course title as it read on the day this was earned. Snapshotted, not fetched — a course renamed two years later must not silently rewrite what somebody was certified in.
fields.label: Course Title

fields.description: The exact version that was passed. This is the anchor of the whole record — everything else about the content can be reconstructed from it.
fields.label: Course Version

fields.description: Version number as published, kept alongside the link so the record still reads correctly if the version document is ever retired.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Fingerprint of the content as published. Proves which exact material this person passed, independently of anything that happens to the records afterwards.
fields.label: Content Hash

fields.description: Superseded means the course changed materially since — the completion is real history, but it no longer proves the person knows the current material. Revoked is a deliberate withdrawal and always carries a reason.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Who earned it. The canonical identity throughout the module — a customer contact has one of these just as an employee does.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Filled in from the user when the record is created, then left alone. Somebody who has since left the company still passed the course.
fields.label: Employee

fields.description: For a customer contact, the account they belong to — this is how a client is shown who on their side has been trained.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: The attempt this came out of. Kept for the working detail behind the result; the numbers here are the record, not the ones still on the attempt.
fields.label: Attempt

fields.description: The supervisor's attestation, for courses that require one. Deferred in Phase 1 because a Link naming a DocType the app does not ship fails bench migrate; restored in Phase 4 with the doctype it points at.
fields.label: Sign-off

fields.description: How much of the required video was watched, as measured at the time.
fields.label: Video Coverage

fields.description: When this stops counting and the course has to be taken again. Blank means it does not expire.
fields.label: Expires On

fields.description: The certificate issued off this completion, if the course issues one. Written back by training/certificates.py after on_submit has created it — hence allow_on_submit, since the completion is submitted by the time the certificate exists.
fields.label: Certificate

fields.description: The version whose material change superseded this one, so it is answerable why somebody was asked to retake a course they had already passed.
fields.label: Superseded By

fields.description: Why this completion was withdrawn. Required when it is cancelled — a certification that quietly disappears is the thing an auditor asks about.
fields.label: Revoked Because
